tool.name: RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub
tool.description: Build a Gwips RiboSeq track hub from bigWig and bigBed files
tool.command:
## Generate a random 15-character folder ID so each run gets a unique URL #import uuid #set $rand_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:15]
## Ensure the output directory is writable and create the unique subfolder chmod 777 /export/galaxy/hub_output 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p /export/galaxy/hub_output/genomebrowsertrack/${rand_id} &&
## Run RiboHub /tool_deps/_conda/bin/ribohub generate --output-dir /export/galaxy/hub_output/genomebrowsertrack/${rand_id} --output-format single-file --genome '$genome' --metadata /data/metadata.csv #if $samples --samples '$samples' #end if #set $kind_list = [] #if $kinds.kind_all #silent $kind_list.append("all") #end if #if $kinds.kind_unique #silent $kind_list.append("unique") #end if #if $kinds.kind_multi #silent $kind_list.append("multi") #end if #if $kind_list --kinds '${",".join($kind_list)}' #end if #if $with_aggregates --with-aggregates #else --no-aggregates #end if #if $with_regions --with-regions #else --no-regions #end if #if $metadata_filter --filter '$metadata_filter' #end if #if str($hub_name).strip() --hub-name '$hub_name' #end if $dry_run
## Write the public hub URL to Galaxy's output dataset #if not $dry_run #set $hub_label = str($hub_name).strip() if str($hub_name).strip() else "RiboSeqHub" && echo "http://\${SERVER_IP}/genomebrowsertrack/${rand_id}/${hub_label}.hub.txt" > '$hub_output' #end if

param.name: samples
param.label: Sample list
param.help: CSV (first column = SRR IDs) or plain text (one SRR per line). Leave empty if using metadata filter only.

param.name: metadata_filter
param.label: Filter samples from metadata (optional)
param.help: Select samples by metadata values. Format: COL=VAL, COL=A|B (OR within field), comma-separated (AND across fields). Example: CELL_LINE=HEK293,CONDITION=High

param.name: with_aggregates
param.label: Include strand overlays
param.help: Per-sample transparent overlay of forward + reverse strands.

param.name: with_regions
param.label: Include region annotations
param.help: Include bigBed region tracks (e.g. ORFs) if available.

param.name: hub_name
param.label: Hub name (optional)
param.help: Default: RiboSeqHub. Changes the hub filename and UCSC identifier. No spaces.

param.name: dry_run
param.label: Dry run
param.help: Preview what would be built without writing any files.

tool.help:
**RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub**
Builds a Gwips track hub from sorted bigWig files produced by the RiboSeqOrg pipeline.
-----
**How to use**
Upload a sample list (CSV or text file with SRR IDs), or use the metadata filter to select samples by their properties, or both. Leave the sample list empty and just fill in the filter to select by metadata only.
-----
**What you get**
A **Hub URL** in your Galaxy history. Copy it and paste into GWIPS-viz under My Data -> Track Hubs -> My Hubs.
Each run generates a unique URL so previous hubs are never overwritten.
-----
**Metadata filter examples**
- ``CELL_LINE=HEK293`` — all HEK293 samples - ``CONDITION=High|Test`` — High OR Test condition - ``CELL_LINE=HEK293,CONDITION=High`` — HEK293 AND High condition - ``TISSUE=Kidney,LIBRARYTYPE=Ribo-Seq`` — kidney Ribo-Seq samples
